```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

sp <- params$species
csv_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "csv")

read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  csv_df <- utils::read.csv(
    path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )
  if (nrow(csv_df) == 0) NULL else csv_df
}

dt <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$p(htmltools::em("No data.")))
  }
  DT::datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}

species_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "species_stats.csv"))
rrmse_per_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "rRMSE_per_usm.csv"))
rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path(csv_dir, "species_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)

# Scatter plot files for this species live alongside this rendered page, so
# bare filenames resolve directly. Ordered from most to least degraded using
# `rrmse_comparison`'s species-level rRMSE ratio (falls back to filesystem
# order - alphabetical by variable - if that data isn't available).
scatter_paths <- Sys.glob("*_scatter_plot.html")
scatter_vars <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(scatter_paths))
scatter_vars <- sub("_scatter_plot$", "", scatter_vars)

ratio <- rep(NA_real_, length(scatter_vars))
has_ratio <- !is.null(rrmse_comparison) &&
  all(c("species", "variable", "rrmse_ratio") %in% names(rrmse_comparison))
if (has_ratio) {
  sp_comp <- rrmse_comparison[rrmse_comparison$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
  ratio <- sp_comp$rrmse_ratio[match(scatter_vars, sp_comp$variable)]
}
ord <- order(-ifelse(is.na(ratio), -Inf, ratio))
scatter_paths <- scatter_paths[ord]
scatter_vars <- scatter_vars[ord]
```

if (length(other_species) > 1) {
  cat(paste(

    "}",
    ".species-nav a, .species-nav .species-nav-current {",
    "  padding: 0.3em 0.9em; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.9em;",
    "  text-decoration: none;",
    "}",
    ".species-nav a { background: #f0f0f0; color: #2c3e50; }",
    ".species-nav a:hover { background: #e0e0e0; }",
    ".species-nav .species-nav-current {",
    "  background: #2c3e50; color: white; font-weight: 600;",
    "}",
    "</style>\n",
    sep = "\n"
  ))

  cat('<nav class="species-nav">\n')
  for (other in other_species) {
    if (identical(other, sp)) {
      cat(sprintf('<span class="species-nav-current">%s</span>\n', other))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf('<a href="../%s/species.html">%s</a>\n', other, other))
    }
  }
  cat("</nav>\n\n")
}

dt(species_stats[species_stats$species == sp, , drop = FALSE])

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(rrmse_per_usm) && "species" %in% names(rrmse_per_usm)) {
  cat("**rRMSE per USM**\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    dt(rrmse_per_usm[rrmse_per_usm$species == sp, , drop = FALSE])
  ))
  cat("\n\n")
}

comparison_path <- "species_comparison.png"
if (file.exists(comparison_path)) {
  cat("**Comparison plot**\n\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    '<img src="%s" style="max-width:100%%; border:1px solid #ddd;">\n\n', # nolint: line_length_linter
    comparison_path
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.callout-note}\n",
    "Why some variables above have no scatter plot below: a variable ",
    "is colored Critical or Warning here as soon as its species-level ",
    "rRMSE ratio crosses the threshold, but the evaluation system ",
    "additionally requires more than 10 observations (`n_obs > 10`) ",
    "before flagging a variable as deteriorated. A variable with fewer ",
    "observations can still show up as Critical or Warning above, but ",
    "won't get an individual scatter plot below - it isn't considered ",
    "statistically reliable enough to trigger one.\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}

for (i in seq_along(scatter_paths)) {
  cat(sprintf("**Scatter plot: %s**\n\n", scatter_vars[i]))
  cat(sprintf(
    '<iframe src="%s" style="width:100%%; height:450px; border:none;"></iframe>\n\n', # nolint: line_length_linter
    scatter_paths[i]
  ))
}
```
